reviews.title: First gen hydroshift issues =*(
reviews.comment:
Had issues with this unit that I built for my buddies pc. Screen flickers and freaks out a bit. Unfortunate...Hoping the newer Hydroshift models are not as prone to this problem, as Lian-Li has definitely taken a hit to their reputation with their hydroshift 1 line. Reddit is plagued with reports of problems =*(.
Been using their Newer Hydroshift II's, no problems so far, but crossing my fingers.
